instruction: Could you open the hyperlink from the newest message in the Bills folder and display it in a Chrome tab?

metadata.explanation: Variation 1: Different paraphrase of the instruction. Task requires opening the first link from the newest email in Bills folder. Evaluator verifies the amazon.com link is opened as a new tab along with the existing two tabs. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks if amazon.com tab is open, without verifying the URL actually came from the newest Bills folder message
No verification that Thunderbird Bills folder was accessed
No verification that the message is the newest one
No verification that the hyperlink was extracted from an email message
Hardcoded expected URL (amazon.com) instead of dynamically extracting from email content
Incomplete requirement coverage - only verifies final tab state, not the source of the URL
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a getter to extract the newest email from Thunderbird's Bills folder and parse its hyperlink
Compare the extracted hyperlink against the newly opened tab URL instead of hardcoding amazon.com
Add verification that the Thunderbird Bills folder was accessed during task execution
Use a metric that validates the URL source (from email) rather than just checking tab existence
Consider adding intermediate state checks (Bills folder opened, email selected, link extracted) for better verification
